source: claude-code subagent (viewed all 3 contact sheets + profile + transcript; YouTube offers no transcript for this video, so story is read from burned-in subtitles)
summary: An access-driven Gambia episode in which the creator spends a week alongside a presidential candidate (a 'Talib' campaign T-shirt is visible at 0:10). Most of it is observational: car ride-alongs, security staff opening SUV doors, community clean-up activity and a long sit-down in a mayor's office. Black interstitial cards ('ZERO TO £100M', 'THE NEXT DAY') reset the chronology. Pieces to camera in a hotel corridor and an office state the stakes ('He's running for president and I'm here to support him'). The film ends on an extended in-car conversation with the candidate and closes on 'NEXT RELEASE' and 'SEE YOU NEXT TIME' black cards.
hook_analysis: In medias res. The film opens in a dark car interior with a magenta-lit window at 0:00, cuts to campaign supporters at 0:10 and an SUV at a restaurant entrance at 0:20, and only then shows the series card at 0:30. Context comes after it, from in-car subtitles ('we just wrapped up a couple of activities'). The viewer is placed inside the entourage before being told why. A radio line in the subtitles at 1:19 ('...the presidential election is here') supplies the stakes without a presenter.
narrative_arc: Day-by-day chronology. Day 1 (0:39-3:17) covers the car, the candidate's home and a community clean-up ('Set-settal', 2:18). 'THE NEXT DAY' (3:27) leads to a stakes-setting piece to camera at 4:07-4:46, then a hotel, a car, and a restaurant meeting (7:14-8:23). After a short wrap piece to camera (9:23-10:02), a second 'THE NEXT DAY' (10:12) leads to the mayor's office: a piece to camera with facts (10:52-11:51), then a long observational interview with the mayor (12:01-14:58). The climax is a reflective in-car conversation about leadership and risk (15:28-17:26), followed by end cards.
camera_and_composition: Handheld observational framing. Car interiors are shot in profile against bright windows, sometimes as near-silhouettes (5:55-6:15, 15:48-17:26). There is a dashboard POV of the street (6:25), and a rear-view-mirror detail with a campaign air-freshener reading 'A NEW GAMBIA IS POSSIBLE' (15:18). Pieces to camera are eye-level medium close-ups with shallow depth of field (4:07-4:46). The mayor scene holds a static wide two-shot in which the presenter sits frame right and partly cut off (12:10-14:58). Exact cuts and camera moves are not observable at storyboard resolution.
color_and_grade: Warm overall (mean warmth 0.09), with red/terracotta walls dominating the restaurant and office scenes (palette #633729, #953836). Car windows clip to magenta/pink (0:00, 0:39-0:59, 6:35), which looks like a deliberate or tolerated stylisation. Exteriors are saturated greens and oranges. Shadows are kept fairly dark (low-key tag on the opening scene).
sound_and_music: Not measurable: YouTube offers no transcript and no audio was downloaded. Burned-in subtitles show continuous dialogue through most scenes, plus one on-screen caption describing radio audio at 1:19. Subtitles continue over the black 'NEXT RELEASE' card at 17:36, so dialogue audio probably runs under the end card.
what_to_borrow: Open inside the moving car or the action, and hold the title card until about 30 s in
Use plain black text interstitials ('THE NEXT DAY') to mark time jumps in a multi-day trip
Use one direct piece to camera to state the stakes, placed after the viewer has already seen the world
Let a long in-car conversation be the emotional climax instead of a montage
Use found text in the environment (campaign air-freshener, T-shirts) as story exposition
what_to_avoid_copying: 'ZERO TO £100M' series card and 'NEXT RELEASE dd/mm/yyyy' cards (creator branding)
Clipped magenta car windows, unless you want that look on purpose
Static, unvaried two-shot held for almost 3 minutes (12:10-14:58); this only works when the speaker carries it

observations.name: in medias res cold open
observations.description: A dark car interior with a magenta-clipped window, campaign supporters in a candidate T-shirt, and an SUV at a restaurant. All of this comes before any title.

observations.name: series title card
observations.description: 'ZERO TO £100M' in small white type on black: a hard reset after the cold open.

observations.name: car ride-along with subtitles
observations.description: Profile of a passenger in the back seat with burned-in subtitles explaining the day's plan.

observations.name: subtitled radio cue
observations.description: Dashboard POV with an on-screen caption describing radio audio about the presidential election. It gives exposition without narration.

observations.name: home-visit detail and host
observations.description: Framed family portraits as a cutaway, then the host in a purple kaftan laughing on a sofa.

observations.name: piece to camera outdoors
observations.description: Presenter in a black tee against palms explains the community clean-up and the donation.

observations.name: time-jump interstitial
observations.description: 'THE NEXT DAY' in bold white on black.

observations.name: stakes-setting piece to camera
observations.description: Hotel-corridor medium close-up: he has been here a week, the candidate is running for president, it's a poor country.

observations.name: walk-and-follow with security
observations.description: A wide shot walking through hotel grounds, then security staff in khaki uniforms opening SUV doors.

observations.name: observational restaurant meeting
observations.description: Two men at a white-clothed table against red walls, filmed fly-on-the-wall from a fixed angle with subtitles.

observations.name: interstitial over action
observations.description: 'THE NEXT DAY' laid over an exterior shot of an official in uniform, a variation on the black card.

observations.name: fact-led piece to camera
observations.description: In an office, the presenter delivers figures and history (GDP, independence) straight to the lens.

observations.name: long observational interview
observations.description: Static wide two-shot of the mayor in white talking about responsibility and the presidency for nearly 3 minutes.

observations.name: in-car conversation climax
observations.description: Close profile of the candidate in a turtleneck, gesturing as he explains why he is taking the risk. The window is blown out.

observations.name: end cards with audio under
observations.description: 'NEXT RELEASE' then 'SEE YOU NEXT TIME' on black. Subtitles continue under the first card.
